InstallNoVerify.because: the installer moves the downloaded file into place without comparing its SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS, so a damaged download becomes the installed binary

InstallLinkFirst.because: the installer switches the link before the asset is in place, so a crash between the two steps leaves the link pointing at a file that is not there

RuntimeBuiltInPlace.because: the installer builds the pinned runtime in its final directory instead of a staging directory, so a crash or a failed package install leaves a half-built runtime where the module looks for it

RuntimeNoVerify.because: the installer builds from a runtime lock without comparing its SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS, so a damaged or swapped lock decides which packages are installed
